title: extractAfter
summary: Extract text after a position or boundary.

gpu_support.notes: No GPU kernel is registered. Documented text and numeric position inputs are host values; gathering a resident numeric position is an independently gated RunMat extension.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: `extractAfter(text, boundary)` returns the text after the first matching text/pattern boundary or after a one-based numeric position. The output preserves the text input datatype and shape.

inputs.name: boundary
inputs.description: Text/pattern boundary or positive numeric position, supplied as a scalar or an array the same size as the text input.

behaviors: Numeric positions are one-based structural controls. Scalar positions expand to every text element; nonscalar positions must have exactly the same shape as the text input.
All eight built-in integer classes are read from native storage without floating-point conversion. Single and double positions must be finite positive integer values.
String arrays, character vectors, and cell arrays of character vectors preserve their input datatype and shape. Row-wise character matrices and broader cell containers are explicit RunMat extensions.
Missing text propagates. A text or pattern boundary that cannot be found is reported as an error by the current RunMat implementation.
Integer, logical, complex, and resident numeric values are not accepted as text. Resident numeric positions require the RunMat extension mode and are gathered before host evaluation.
